yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ yo ga shud+dha la sogs pa'i sngags brjod nas/ lha rnams kyi zhal nas byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ om̐ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + badz+ra ) ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa gsum dang | so so'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ om̐ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa un mā da a pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+p+re yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+taṃ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi wa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kār+t+ta ya sat+su khaṃ/ bi shud+dhā ya/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phul nas/ phyi dang nang gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas/ /bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/

/bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ / rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog 'khor bcas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol | | srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang | | gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa

( ¡¶ lu ¡· rnams ) med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang | | 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas gsol ba btab nas | rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod la/ bzod par gsol te/ mgron gshegs su gsol nas gtor ma dor ro/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// //kha zas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i snying gar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lte bar 'byung po'i tshogs bsams nas/ lag pa g.yon gyi mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang | mdun phyogs nas g.yon skor gyis 'dab ma rnams la/ om̐ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hri ྃmam̐ | hre ྃhriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa rnams dpa' mo drug dang*/ mthe bo la sogs pa'i sen mo lnga dang*/ bsdus pa'i 'dom so rnams su/ om̐ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa ham̐/ dpa' bo drug ste/ thams cad kyang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par dmigs la so so'i sngags/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas shing zhu ba dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas kyis mchod la/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes pas tshim par bsam zhing*/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas lha rnams lus la thim par bsams nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs | kha thab khung*/ kha zas rnams bsreg rdzas su dmigs la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du bza'a'o/ /lhag ma om̐ u ts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sā+-i swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// //spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor rnams rang gi lus la bsdus pa la go cha gnyis bkod nas/ srung 'khor gyi skabs ltar sum bha ni'i sngags lan gnyis kyis phyogs mtshams bcings la/

bdag dang snang ba thams cad he ru ka brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du shes par byas nas/ yul gyi lhas nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ yul rnams la sdang zhen med par longs spyad do | | spyod lam mo/ /de ltar rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa goms pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa rnams kyi mthar phyin par byas pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams bgrod de/ nye ba'i rgyus mtshams sbyar nas rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ lwa wa pa bar pa/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ dge ba'i mgon po/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham 'thing pa sku mched/ bal po bha dan+ta/ mar do lo tswa ba chos kyi dbang phyugagaze pa blo ldan seng ge gze pa bde mchog rdo rje/ slob dpon shākya rdo rje/ slob dpon mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rnams so/ /he ru ka dpal mnyes byed cho ga lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dri med lung dang bstan bcos rnams las gsal bar gyur mod de lta na'ang*/ /'di la 'dun pas bskul ba'i don du lung dang man ngag ji bzhin du/ /bdag gis sbyar ba'i dge ba gang des bdag gzhan he ru kar gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon rdo rje'i dril bu pas mdzad pa'i nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du zhugs shing 'dir 'dun pa'i thugs rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i rgyal bu ji big de mur gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes bya bas chu mo bya'i lo/ de bzhin gshegs pas cho 'phrul ¡Ã chen po

( ¡¶ zha ¡· - chen po ) bstan pa'i zla ba la/ shing kun mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// //༄༅/ /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la ( ¡¶ zha ¡· oṃ swāsti sing+nghaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas*/ ) phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu stong pa'i bdag nyid can/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dngos/ /he ru ka dpal la btud de/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad | | dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par stan bde bar bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du bde mchog bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba shung+ngho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje | g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ g.yon gyi cha la tshes gcig gi zla bas ¡Ã brgyan zhing mtshog ma'i steng du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· mtshan pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu ) sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas u ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/

sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ ) gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka mnyam par sbyor zhing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /de nas thugs ka nas sangs rgyas rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros nas/ sems can thams cad lhan skyes kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsams nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka 'ba' zhig yin la/ de dag thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'o snyam du bsams nas de la yid mnyam par bzhag go / bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por byas nas/ lte ba'i nang du a shad kyi rnam pa lta bu phra ba rtsub pa ngar dang ldan pa gcig bsams la/ de'-i nus pas rang gi sdig pa dang nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsregs/ spyi bo ¡Ã dang snying ga nas byang sems 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu phab pa rtsa dbu ma nas brgyud ( ¡¶ zha ¡· byung chub kyi sems phab ) / des lus thams cad khyab pas lus thams cad bde bas gang*/ bde bas rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ goms na drod dang bde ba dang*/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ snying gi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po

¡Ã dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar bam̐ dmar po bsams la/ hūm̐ las ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gcig bsam/ de las ) sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi rnam pa byung ba rang gi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon/ yab kyi rdo rje'i sbu gur zhugs shing 'khor bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsam zhing | om̐ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi dang*/ om̐ sarba bung+ngha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yab yum gyi sngags sbrail ba'am so so ba ci nus bzlas so/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// //khrus byed pa'i tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas rigs lngas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas bdag gi spyi bo nas blugs pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la khrus bya'o | khrus kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma bshams la/ om̐ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ gri h+na gri h+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ gri h+nā pa ya gri h+nā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ ā na ya ho bha ga wāṃ bid+ya rā dzā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsang*/ gong du brjod pa'i swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis stong par bsams/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par bskyed nas | om̐ āḥhūm̐ dang so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog ¡Ã lhan skyes la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor ) spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkha' bzhugs pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/

om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ng+nghū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod nas/ de'i spyan sngar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag nyid skyabs su mchi | | he ru ka dpal sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ /zhes lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sdom pa blang ngo*/ de nas gtor ma sbyangs la/ sum̐ bha'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las | āḥlas khams gsum khyab pa'i thod pa chen po'i nang du/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar bskyed/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang | chos skyong srung mas bskor ba spyan drangs nas/ de rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ om̐ badz+ra ā ral+li ho | ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

) badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bya ba lngas dbul/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma'i mgron dang*/ tshogs kyi zhing badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo/ /mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// //kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe zas de/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang lhar gsal gdab/ lte ba'i gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du/ snying gar bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lto bar chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs rnams dmigs nas | de rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pas longs spyad do/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// //de nas spyod lam ni ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang ¡Ã dang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· lhag pa'i lhar gsal gdab/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas ) snang ba thams cad lhar gsal gdab/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas brtan par byas nas lus kyi bya ba phyag rgya/ ngag tu brjod pa sngags/ sems kyi bsam pa ting nge 'dzin du bsam par bya zhing*/ thams cad du 'khor gsum du zhen pa dang bral bar bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// //rnal 'byor pa rig ma bsten pa yin na/ snyoms 'jug gi rnal 'byor ni rig ma dbang bskur ba thob pa la rung gi ma thob pa la mi rung ngo*/ /de'ang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe ) skad cig gis rang he ru ka dang | rig ma rdo rje phag mor dmigs la/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma as mtshan pa dang | yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed la/ gnyis ka'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar om̐ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod snyam du bsams nas/ chags pa dang bral ba'i tshul gyis bsten par bya'o/ / snyoms 'jug gi rnal 'byor ro/ /nub mor nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad rang la bsdu/

rang snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ stong par yal ba'i ngang la gnyid log go /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// // nangs par ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis rang he ru ka'i skur langs la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad lha'i skur gyur par bltas la ldang ngo*/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi bya ba 'dis yongs su rdzogs par byas na myur du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /skal ldan gdul bya rnams kyi phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i tshul/ /bla ma'i drin gyis gang rtogs pa/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag gis sbyar | | de las byung ba'i dge ba des/ /'gro kun zab mo'i lam zhugs nas/ / sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis brgyan pa/ yan lag bcu pa zhes bya ba 'di/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pa zhes bya ba la/ yu gur gyi yul du skyes pa'i ban+de mngon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa/ saṃ gha mi tra zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ shing mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po la rgya'i yul the ler zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'khor lo bde mchog bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas om̐ swa bhā wa shung+nghaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus rang gi sems pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur par bsgom/ de yang sku mdog sngon po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can | rus pa'i rgyun drug gis brgyan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin pas phyogs bcur bsdigs shing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan zhing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa zung 'jug gi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar bsgom/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar om̐/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba rang gi mdun du spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ yo ga shud+dhaḥ sarba dharma yo ga shung+ngho3 ham̐ gis rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las yig 'bru 'phros pa yab kyi zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs | yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon/ yab kyi gsang gnas su zhugs nas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang gi rgyud la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ om̐ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pa bzla'o// //༈ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa byed par 'dod na/ mchod pa bshams pa rnams | oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa bsang*/ om̐ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las om̐.āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i sgra rnams ngo bo bzang zhing nam mkha' gang bar bskyed/ de nas mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ rang gis bsgoms pa ltar 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba bskyed pa la snga ma ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bstim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes thams cad la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥ hūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab | badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ de nas nang mchod sngar bzhin bsang zhing sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed/ om̐.āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs mtheb srin gyis gtor zhing | sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa mchod par bzhes/ zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ rang gi sngags kyis yi dam dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod par bzhes/ zhes pas de dag la mchod nas/ lce/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas rang gi lus kyi lha mchod nas/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'byung po thams cad mchod ces pas de dag la dbul lo/ / de nas chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma sbyangs pa gong gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pas mdun bskyed kyi he ru ka dang lha thams cad la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje'i thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ om̐ ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ snga ma ltar mchod nas bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud mchod gral dang*/ gtor mar phul bas lha dang 'byung po rnams mchod nas shes rab kyi rdzas las kyi slob mas | 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'du ba rnams la the tshom med/ / bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du bzhes/ /zhes pas drang | len pa pos/ bde gshegs chos la ring thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/

/zhes brjod cing blang*/ phud kyis sngar ltar mchod nas/ rang gi snying gar bla ma dang lha/ lte bar chos skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing longs spyad/ kha zas kyang de dang 'dra bar longs spyad do/ /thabs kyi rdzas la ba la/ shes rab kyi rdzas la ma da na/ bza' ba la kri pi ta/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i rnal 'byor ma nyams par bya'o/ /bza' btung gis tshim pa dang*/ lhag ma bsdus pa nang mchod kyi kha phrus btab nas/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ om̐ u ts+tshiṣ+ta ba lin+ta/ bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la byin nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pa/ /bden pa 'dis ni lha mo 'di dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la/ om̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed gshegs su gsol la/ rang gi gnas gsum/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsrungs nas/ las kyi rjes bsdus la/ ci bde bar spyad do/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'o// //spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ om̐ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags | hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ting nge 'dzin/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsams la yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad do/ /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ nang par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo | | de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed cing*/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa la gnas pa ni ring por mi thogs par he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/
